content.title: Private-Equity Stocks Have Gotten Crushed. J.P. Morgan Says This One Is a Buy.
content.summary: Investors have grown skeptical when it comes to the stock of private asset managers. The private-equity business, once the industry’s bread-and-butter, has slowed as firms have struggled to cash out of companies they have bought and distribute money to investors.
